entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, I don't mean I've been watching you![n]I just read your fortune.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Now that that's cleared up, please[n]take this.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It's to celebrate your freedom. And to[n]say thanks for everything you do.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: If you ever need my power again,[n]all you have to do is ask.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'll always be happy to help you.
